citeAs: Wadhawan, R., Bansal, H., Chang, K.-W., & Peng, N. (2024). CONTEXTUAL: Evaluating Context-Sensitive Text-Rich Visual Reasoning in Large Multimodal Models. Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning.
creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng (University of California Los Angeles)
description: A dataset featuring human-crafted instructions that require context-sensitive reasoning for text-rich images across eight real-world scenarios.
name: CONTEXTUAL
rai:annotatorDemographics: Human annotators, mainly from the US.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: MTurk workers verified the correctness of each sample and found that 96% of the samples were annotated correctly.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Authors were divided into two groups to annotate specific categories following guidelines. MTurk workers then verified the correctness of each image, instruction, and response triplet.
rai:dataBiases: The authors acknowledge that the linguistic diversity and writing style of the human responses would change with different social groups.
rai:dataCollection: Images were sourced from LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative, and existing VQA datasets (InfographicVQA, STVQA, ESTVQA). Authors manually and heuristically filtered images, then annotated them with instruction-response pairs.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images sourced from LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative, InfographicVQA, STVQA, and ESTVQA.
rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images for certain categories underwent heuristic-based filtering using PaddleOCR to detect text, selecting the top 500 images with the highest number of words.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The authors aimed to ensure images, instructions, and responses are not offensive to any social group and did not observe apparent harmful or privacy-sensitive information.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning capabilities of large multimodal models.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: PaddleOCR (used for heuristic-based filtering of images)
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The authors note they did not observe any apparent harmful and privacy sensitive information in the dataset.
